new_claims.statement: There is an explicit exact-rank-three family with c>63/64, every residual transverse physical leverage <1/64, and a residual row failing the account03/B16 r28 duplicated gate, while the physical spectrum is exactly {1,-1,1}; for arbitrary independent cap-one source laws its quadratic output has essential density <211 uniformly in a and diffuse bank size m.

In the same family, one hub plus one coordinate from each of two diffuse banks has physical triple determinant c(1-h)/(2m^2), so the local determinant certificate grows like m^(2/3); aggregating the two disjoint source banks first gives a cap-one triple determinant c(1-h)/8 and a uniform bound <211.

Because the family has exact signature (+,+,-) with unit spectral magnitudes, the pinned ruled theorem gives p_Q(s)<=pi sqrt(2) for almost every s>=0, using two-dimensional product marginals without any projected-coordinate independence assumption.
